title: ACT VI
subtitle: The Sky Dominion
rewardRelicDesc: All your units gain +2 attack at battle start.

intro.title: THE SKY DOMINION
intro.text:
You've climbed out of the sea and into the air.

The Sky Dominion exists on drifting islands — chunks of terrain that broke loose during the Fracture and simply refused to come back down. They've been up here so long they've built cities on them. Militarised them. Connected them with rope-bridges and siege platforms and weapons specifically designed to hit things that are also in the air.

They do not like visitors.

intro.title: THE CLOUDMARSHAL
intro.text:
Command of the Sky Dominion belongs to the Cloudmarshal — a general who has never lost a battle because, practically speaking, her armies have always had the high ground.

She does not consider a tactician without wings a credible threat. She's said this, publicly, several times.

You are going to prove her wrong. You always find this kind of statement motivating.

intro.title: THE LEY BRIDGE
intro.text:
The ley lines rise here — thick, crackling columns of energy that punch up through the clouds and connect to something far above. If the Fractured Core exists anywhere, the ley lines suggest it's in a direction the Cloudmarshal considers her personal airspace.

You will need to break through her defences to reach it.

At least the view will be good.

outro.title: THE CLOUDMARSHAL FALLS
outro.text:
The Cloudmarshal does not surrender. She concedes the tactical situation, which is different, and she does it with the kind of grudging precision you only see in people who have never actually had to admit defeat before.

The ley bridge opens. The sky path clears.

From up here, you can almost see where the Fracture scar runs through the upper atmosphere.

outro.title: WHAT SHE SAID
outro.text:
'You fight without flying,' she said, as you left. 'That shouldn't work.'

You told her you'd never found that to be a meaningful constraint.

She did not look convinced. She did, however, step aside.

outro.title: HIGHER STILL
outro.text:
The Stormcaller's Badge sits in your hand — a Sky Dominion medal, given to the first enemy officer who ever reached the upper platforms.

You aren't an officer. Close enough.

The ley lines point upward. They always do. You've stopped being surprised by that.

cloudbreach.label: Cloud Breach
cloudbreach.description: The first sky-island is defended by aerial sentries. They spotted you three islands ago.

wind-shrine.label: Wind Shrine
wind-shrine.description: A weathervane shrine rattles in the high-altitude gale. Something still listens to it.

eventConfig.title: The Wind Shrine
eventConfig.description: A spinning brass weathervane atop a stone plinth. The wind here is constant and intentional. Whatever it once guided, it's still doing it.

skyport-camp.label: Skyport Shelter
skyport-camp.description: An abandoned skyport mooring dock. The winds are calmer here.

sky-bazaar.label: Sky Bazaar
sky-bazaar.description: A merchant who specialises in goods that fell off other flying islands.

gale-crossing.label: Gale Crossing
gale-crossing.description: The rope-bridge between islands is contested. High winds make it worse.

storm-battery.label: Storm Battery
storm-battery.description: Sky artillery platforms. They were designed to hold an airspace, not a ground approach.

thermal-vent.label: Thermal Column
thermal-vent.description: A natural updraft carries things up from below. Mostly junk. Sometimes not.

eventConfig.title: The Thermal Column
eventConfig.description: A powerful updraft punches through a gap in the island's floor. It carries the smell of the shards below — and loose objects that fell off other islands during the Fracture.

sky-elite.label: Cloudmarshal's Wing
sky-elite.description: The Cloudmarshal's personal aerial squadron. They've been briefed on you.

upper-platform.label: Upper Platform
upper-platform.description: The highest inhabited island. From here you can see the ley bridge — and everything defending it.

archive-isle.label: Cloudmarshal's Log
archive-isle.description: A command post, abandoned in the retreat. The tactical logs are still open.

eventConfig.title: The Command Post
eventConfig.description: An abandoned Dominion command post, still warm from use. Maps, tactical notes, and a half-eaten ration. The logs describe the Fracture from above — and something the Cloudmarshal calls 'the signal.'

pools.label: Read the tactical logs
pools.consequence: The strategy is useful — rare card

pools.label: Read the tactical logs

pools.consequence: First proper shelter in hours — healed 15 HP

pools.label: Rest in the shelter

high-rest.label: Cloudport Rest
high-rest.description: A decommissioned cloudport. Quiet and out of the wind.

summit-elite.label: Summit Guard
summit-elite.description: Last defenders before the Cloudmarshal's position. They've had time to prepare.

cloudmarshal.label: The Cloudmarshal
cloudmarshal.description: General of the Sky Dominion. She has never fought anyone who came up from below before.
bossDialogue: You came up from below. That has never happened before. I'm going to note it in the log.
The high ground is everything. You're standing on mine. That is the last time.
I don't lose. I'm noting that for the record as well.
